patches.name: Uncensor patch
patches.notes: Install (PC): Place the downloaded 'resources.assets' file in the 'DeliciousPGMS_Data' folder inside the game Steam install folder (right click on the game in Steam, Properties, Local Files, Browse Local Files...). NOTE: This will overwrite the censored files, so if you want to re-censor the game later without re-downloading, back up the old resources.assets! It's working if: If successful, Rui's first stage outfit unlock will be the maid outfit (instead of the school uniform). uncensorpat.ch checked this patch on PC.
